PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_SiteWeatherData
PropertySetDef.Definition:
Definition from IAI: Provides access to weather data appropriate to the site and is used for calculating thermal loads.
HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0.
ISSUES: No issues to date.

PropertyDef.Name: Description
PropertyDef.Definition: The site weather data station description or reference to the data source from which weather data was obtained for use in calculations.

PropertyDef.Name: Date
PropertyDef.Definition: The date for which the weather data was gathered.
